N.promptText: [S1] At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text. Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.

J.promptText: [S1] Dude, this game gets me every single time. (laughs) Okay. One more level.

lines.text: At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text.
lines.cap: At *2:47 AM,* a number he didn't know sent him a *text.*

lines.text: Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.
lines.cap: Jay was playing *The Endless Halls.* The game where the tall man only moves when you *look away.*

lines.text: He figured it was a prank.
lines.cap: He figured it was a *prank.*

lines.text: Would you text back? Comment yes or no.
lines.cap: Would you text back? Comment *yes or no.*

lines.text: Probably just his friend Maya, messing with him.
lines.cap: Probably just his friend *Maya,* messing with him.

lines.text: Five minutes later.
lines.cap: *Five minutes later.*

lines.text: Then a photo of his street. It wasn't funny anymore.
lines.cap: Then a photo of *his street.* It wasn't funny anymore.
lines.dia: Then a photo of his street. It wasn't funny anymore. Not at all.

lines.text: He called the number. It just rang... and rang.
lines.cap: He called the number. It just *rang...* and rang.

lines.text: Then nothing. For ten whole minutes.
lines.cap: Then *nothing.* For ten whole minutes.

lines.text: At three-oh-two, his phone lit up again.
lines.cap: At *3:02,* his phone lit up again.

lines.text: His front porch. His house number.
lines.cap: His front porch. *His house number.*

lines.text: Run, or hide? Comment it.
lines.cap: *Run, or hide?* Comment it.

lines.text: He locked the door. Killed the lights. Grabbed the bat.
lines.cap: He locked the door. Killed the lights. Grabbed the *bat.*

lines.text: It came from the kitchen.
lines.cap: It came from the *kitchen.*

lines.text: He called out. Nobody answered.
lines.cap: He called out. *Nobody answered.*

lines.text: The pans were on the floor. The kitchen was empty.
lines.cap: The pans were on the floor. The kitchen was *empty.*
lines.dia: The pans were on the floor. The kitchen was empty. Completely empty.

lines.text: His room. Where he'd just been hiding.
lines.cap: His room. Where he'd just been *hiding.*
lines.dia: His room. Where he'd just been hiding. Right up there.

lines.text: He shut the door... and finally let out a breath.
lines.cap: He shut the door... and finally let out a *breath.*

lines.text: He forgot the only rule of The Endless Halls.
lines.cap: He forgot the only rule of *The Endless Halls...*

lines.text: Never look away.
lines.cap: *Never look away.*

lines.text: What happens next? Comment it.
lines.cap: What happens *next?* Comment it.

lines.text: The Endless Halls is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox.
lines.cap: *The Endless Halls* is one of *tons* of free games on Pulsebox.

lines.text: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer... with the lights on.
lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer...* with the lights on.
